title: insufficient-context mode — only unsorted and questions survive

setup.note: GoldenEvals V6 P1 §5.11 LIV-10, authored at R3. A brand-new DM: no history on the stream, no open or recent episode, no candidate space from retrieval, a sender who resolves to no entity, and a bundle too small to be its own context — decideThin() says thin on all five signals. This is SECOND sight (thin_policy 'instruct'), so the pack carries the insufficient-context instruction instead of holding, and the model is asked anyway. The recorded answer then does the wrong thing on purpose: it files an episode, proposes a space, writes a task and prepares an action. Every one of those is stripped by CODE (parseLiveOutput, live.ts rule 5 / parseLiveDecideAnswer rule 4) before the commit path sees the answer, so the database gets the unsorted entry and the question and nothing else. The stripping is not a prompt promise — the instruction is in the pack too, and the fixture proves the code does not depend on the model reading it.
